[AI engineering](../index.qmd) / Retrieval and grounding

Help a model answer from the right evidence, and make that evidence inspectable.

## What to understand

- **Ingestion:** extraction, OCR where necessary, document structure, deduplication, refreshes and source permissions.
- **Indexing:** chunk boundaries, metadata, embedding choices, vector indexes and keyword search.
- **Retrieval:** query rewriting, metadata filters, hybrid search, reranking and context assembly.
- **Grounded answers:** quotations, citations, source locations, uncertainty and abstention when evidence is missing.
- **Evaluation:** retrieval relevance and coverage separately from answer correctness and citation support.
- **Maintenance:** changed documents, stale indexes, deletions, access-controlled search and adversarial source text.

## How the pieces connect

RAG means retrieval-augmented generation: retrieve evidence and supply it to the model. It can improve access to information without retraining the model.

## A question to test

Ask ten questions whose answers live in your documents and a few whose answers do not. Inspect retrieved passages before judging generated answers.
